headline: Review of the City's use of and contracts for Automated License Plate Readers and Flock Safety cameras.
summary: The Legal Affairs and Public Services Committees will hold a joint meeting to review the City's use of and contracts for Automated License Plate Readers and associated software, including Flock Safety cameras.
